act.long_title: An Act to consolidate, define and amend the law of Evidence.

licence: Published with commentary and other original matter under s.52(1)(q)(ii), Copyright Act 1957.

section.heading: Who may give evidence of agreement varying terms of document
section.html: Persons who are not parties to a document, or their representatives in interest, may give evidence of any facts tending to show a contemporaneous agreement varying the terms of the document. Illustration A and B make a contract in writing that B shall sell A certain cotton, to be paid for on delivery. At the same time they make an oral agreement that three months credit shall be given to A. This could not be shown as between A and B, but it might be shown by C, if it affected his interests.
